description: This file contains the definition of the VardefManager class responsible for managing variable definitions (vardefs) for modules in a CRM system. It includes methods for creating, loading, cleaning, caching, and refreshing vardefs, as well as handling module templates and link fields.

classes.name: VardefManager
classes.description: A class that manages variable definitions (vardefs) in the CRM system, including creation, loading, validation, caching, and refresh operations for module vardefs.

methods.name: createVardef
methods.description: Loads vardefs for a module and object using specified templates and language support.

methods.name: setCustomAllowedForModule
methods.description: Enables or disables custom vardef loading for a specific module.

methods.name: addTemplate
methods.description: Adds a template's vardefs to a module's vardefs, merging fields, relationships, and indices.

methods.name: cleanVardefs
methods.description: Removes invalid field definitions from vardefs.

methods.name: saveCache
methods.description: Saves the module's vardefs to a cache file and updates global cache.

methods.name: clearVardef
methods.description: Clears cached vardefs for a specific module/object or all modules.

methods.name: _clearCache
methods.description: Helper to remove cache files and clear cached vardefs for a specific module/object.

methods.name: refreshVardefs
methods.description: Refreshes vardefs by searching various locations, reloading or regenerating cache files.

methods.name: getLinkFieldsForModule
methods.description: Retrieves link-type fields for a module's object, caching results for efficiency.

methods.name: getLinkFieldForRelationship
methods.description: Retrieves link field definitions for a given relationship, using cache for performance.

methods.name: applyGlobalAccountRequirements
methods.description: Adjusts vardefs to enforce global account name requirements based on configuration.

methods.name: loadVardef
methods.description: Loads vardefs for a module and object, refreshing cache if necessary.
